title: Spanning-Tree Maximization Forces Isoperimetry in the Square Lattice
summary: Lean formalization of spanning-tree maximization over finite connected induced subgraphs of the square lattice. The development establishes edge isoperimetry of every maximizer, the maximum count and all maximizing lattice-isometry classes at every positive cardinality, and uniqueness of the canonical corner-strip domain for N >= 18. Nonuniqueness occurs exactly at N = 3, 8, 10, 13; the canonical count has exceptions at N = 7, 14, 17.
